hints.content: The ratio of shaded pieces to total pieces is $\blueE4:10$.

Percent means per hundred.  

So, we need an equivalent ratio that will tell us how many pieces would be shaded out of $100$ total pieces.

|||
-|-|-|-
Shaded | ${4}$ | $\stackrel{\times 10}\rightarrow$ | ${40}$
Parts per whole | $10$ | $\stackrel{\times 10}\rightarrow$  | $100$

![](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/7e7cc216c586c846e91b42f7cf594a6826e53004)

We can also divide the ten pieces into a hundred and see that $\blueE{4}:10$ is equivalent to $\blueE{40}:100$.
